preconditions.description: The number of points n is between 1 and 30.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 10**9 for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: All x coordinates of the points are between 0 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= y <= 10**9 for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: All y coordinates of the points are between 0 and 10^9.
The number of points is equal to n.

postconditions.expression: all(color in ['black', 'white'] for color in colors)
postconditions.description: Each point is assigned either 'black' or 'white' color.

postconditions.expression: all((x1 != x2 or y1 != y2) for (x1, y1), (x2, y2) in zip(line_points, line_points[1:]))
postconditions.description: The line points do not coincide.

postconditions.expression: all((colors[i] == 'black' and ((line_points[0][0] - line_points[1][0]) * (points[i][1] - line_points[1][1]) - (line_points[0][1] - line_points[1][1]) * (points[i][0] - line_points[1][0])) > 0) or (colors[i] == 'white' and ((line_points[0][0] - line_points[1][0]) * (points[i][1] - line_points[1][1]) - (line_points[0][1] - line_points[1][1]) * (points[i][0] - line_points[1][0])) < 0) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Black points lie on one side of the line and white points lie on the other side.
